summary.en: Loomy (iFlytek): network-only sign-in (SMS / pasted session) with no official client required, the official chat request reproduced header-for-header, no injected system prompt, hardened credentials, and credit pools (daily / permanent / team) reported as the host routes them.
summary.zh: 讯飞 Loomy：纯网络登录（短信 / 粘贴 session），不依赖官方客户端；聊天请求逐头复刻官方；不注入系统提示词；凭据脱敏与上游白名单加固；今日池 / 永久池 / 团队池按宿主路由语义上报。
